repairs.claim: The dense GEMM is issued as Out[N,M] = W[N,K] * X[K,M] in column-major with leading dimensions N, K and N, so no leading dimension depends on the token count.
Every timed batch is preceded by one untimed priming launch, so the timed region measures back-to-back kernels rather than one post-synchronization launch.
Every timed batch records the host wall time of its launch loop before any synchronization.
An instrumentation control times the same 64 launches with an event every 1, 4, 16 and 64 repetitions and times an event-only chain with no kernels.
The decode attention kernel carries four independent online-softmax accumulators per warp.

fatal_guards.claim: Every scored cell whose instrumented chain median exceeds 60 microseconds has a per-repetition coefficient of variation, over the clock-stationary part of its diagnostic chain, of at most 0.02 plus q divided by sqrt(12) times the median.

The instrumentation control returns a per-boundary event cost in [1.0, 4.0] microseconds, and for every scored cell the batch-mean constant agrees with the instrumentation-corrected per-repetition mean within 3 percent.
No scored cell is host-issue bound: in every scored batch the recorded host launch-loop wall time is at most 0.8 times the device elapsed time of the same batch.
The instrumentation control executed and reported a per-boundary cost, a per-stride table over strides 1, 4, 16 and 64, and an event-only chain period.

survivable_guard_remainder.on_failure: the cell is marked host_issue_bound, excluded from every scored expectation, from every other guard that quantifies over scored cells, and from the published profile table, and reported with its host and device times
survivable_guard_remainder.remains_interpretable: every expectation none of whose cells were excluded, evaluated unchanged; an expectation that loses a cell is reported as evaluated over a reduced scope with the excluded cells named; an expectation whose entire scope is excluded is reported as unevaluated, never as a pass

unscored_records_added: per-batch host launch-loop wall time of every cell
instrumentation control per-stride table and event-only chain period
run-1 evaluation of every scored expectation published beside run 2
cells excluded by G13 with their host and device times
